title: African Warrior Fantasy
content: Imaro II: The Quest for Cushis a fantasy novel written by Charles Saunders, an expert in African folklore. I wanted Imaro to be a convincing warrior hero, so I located a tall, built model named Darrell, who was in training to play for the L.A. Lakers. That’s Mount Kenya in the distance.-----Imaro II: The Quest for Cushon Amazon
